label: Blind sample burn 015: MTBS Hancock Creek fire, NC, 2022-04-14

verdict.headline: Real change
verdict.statement: Burn ratio (NBR) fell by 0.07 relative to the control trajectory in the 6 months after 14 Apr 2022 (90% interval −0.11 to −0.04). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 0 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.02). Counted by gap size instead, 0 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.02).

evidence.sentence: Optical shows the change (burn ratio (NBR) fell by 0.07); radar is inconclusive (radar backscatter (VH) −0.2 dB, interval −0.3 to −0.1).
